name: Vector space
description: Algebraic structure (V, +, scalar_mul) over field F satisfying 8 axioms: closure under addition + scalar multiplication, associativity, commutativity, identity, inverse, distributivity. Foundation for linear algebra + substrate codebook representations + HRR/FHRR/TPR algebraic structures.

name: Real field R
description: Complete ordered field of real numbers. Foundation for substrate HRR (float32) algebra + analysis + measure theory. Distinguished from complex field by ordering property + lack of root closure.

name: Complex field C
description: Algebraically closed field of complex numbers a+bi. Foundation for substrate FHRR algebra (complex64 phasor representation) + Fourier analysis + spectral theory. Algebraically closed: every polynomial has C-root.

name: Eigenvalue + eigenvector
description: For linear operator A: pair (lambda, v) with A v = lambda v, v != 0. Foundation for spectral theory + substrate Layer 2 observability (tw_edge_z, spectral_gap, mp_bulk_kl). Eigenvalues characterize operator action; eigenvectors are invariant directions.

name: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
description: Factorization A = U Sigma V^T for any matrix A in R^MxN. U + V orthonormal; Sigma diagonal singular values sigma_i >= 0. Foundation for low-rank approximation + PCA + spectral analysis + Marchenko-Pastur distribution analysis. SVD generalizes eigendecomposition to non-square matrices.

name: Marchenko-Pastur distribution
description: Limiting eigenvalue distribution of (1/N) X X^T for random matrix X in R^MxN with iid entries, as M,N -> inf with M/N -> lambda fixed. Bulk density supported on [lambda_minus, lambda_plus]; foundation for substrate codebook randomness baseline + Layer 2 mp_bulk_kl divergence measure.

name: Tracy-Widom distribution
description: Limiting distribution of largest eigenvalue (after rescaling) of random matrix ensembles (GUE, GOE, GSE). Foundation for substrate Layer 2 tw_edge_z measure: substrate atoms with tw_edge_z negative = structured codebook (atoms more clustered than random). Tail behavior asymmetric.

name: Voiculescu free probability
description: Non-commutative probability theory generalizing classical probability to operator-valued random variables. Foundation for substrate free-probability observability framework (kappa_4_rect free cumulant; spectral analysis of compositions). Free convolution replaces classical convolution for spectral measures.

name: Probability space
description: Triple (Omega, F, P) consisting of sample space + sigma-algebra + probability measure. Foundation for probability theory + Bayesian inference + substrate count-NB + HMM emissions. Kolmogorov axioms grounding.

name: Expectation + variance
description: First two moments of random variable: E[X] = integral X dP (linear functional); Var[X] = E[(X - E[X])^2]. Foundation for substrate uncertainty quantification (conformal + isotonic) + free-probability moments + statistical learning theory.

name: Kullback-Leibler divergence
description: Asymmetric measure D_KL(P || Q) = integral P log(P/Q) of how distribution Q differs from P. Non-negative; 0 iff P=Q. Foundation for substrate Layer 2 mp_bulk_kl measure + BOCPD changepoint detection + EM algorithm convergence + drift detection.

name: Limit of function
description: lim_{x -> a} f(x) = L: epsilon-delta definition foundation for calculus + continuity + analysis. Substrate-relevant: limits underlie convergence analysis of EM + gradient descent + Hopfield dynamics + iterative cleanup.

name: Derivative
description: f'(x) = lim_{h -> 0} (f(x+h) - f(x))/h: instantaneous rate of change. Foundation for gradient + Jacobian + optimization (gradient descent). Substrate gradient-descent training + backprop analogues.

name: Integral
description: Riemann/Lebesgue integral: limit of Riemann sums / Lebesgue measure-theoretic. Foundation for expectation + measure theory + convolution + Fourier transform. Substrate-relevant: integrate-then-discretize patterns in spectral measures.

name: Gradient
description: del f = (df/dx_1, ..., df/dx_n) vector of partial derivatives. Direction of steepest ascent. Foundation for gradient descent + backprop + substrate weight updates in discriminative perceptron + EM.

name: Group
description: Algebraic structure (G, *) with closure + associativity + identity + inverse. Abelian if commutative. Foundation for substrate HRR (cyclic group via convolution) + FHRR (complex unit circle group U(1)) + GHRR (matrix group GL(N)).

name: Ring + field
description: Ring: abelian group under + with associative multiplication distributing over +. Field: commutative ring with multiplicative inverses (except 0). Foundation for algebraic structure of substrate codebooks + linear algebra over R or C.

name: Metric space
description: Pair (X, d) with distance function d: X x X -> [0, inf) satisfying non-negativity + identity + symmetry + triangle inequality. Foundation for substrate cleanup retrieval (cosine + euclidean) + topology + analysis.

name: Measure space
description: Triple (X, F, mu) of set + sigma-algebra + measure. Foundation for integration + probability + Lebesgue theory + substrate-relevant continuous + discrete distribution unification.

name: Graph (V, E)
description: Pair (V, E) of vertex set + edge set. Foundation for graph algorithms + substrate relation structures + Chu-Liu-Edmonds tree decoding + Layer 3 archaeology relation analysis.

name: Tensor product representation (TPR)
description: Smolensky 1990 substrate-product binding via role x filler outer product. Bound representation R F^T preserves both role + filler explicitly. Supports multi-occurrence binding via explicit tensor positions. Distinguished from HRR/FHRR by preserving full tensor dimension (no folding).

metadata.substrate_role: non-unique role binding alternative to FHRR

name: Sparse distributed memory (SDM)
description: Kanerva 1988 + Frady-Sommer 2020 high-dimensional vector memory using sparse address spaces. Storage via address-content paired binding; retrieval via cleanup over distributed activation. Substrate-relevant: capacity scaling 0.15 N items per Hebbian rule; basis for substrate v3.2 SDM-multi-substrate wrapper.

name: AGS Hopfield capacity (0.138 N)
description: Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky 1985 capacity theorem for Hopfield network with N neurons: M_max = 0.138 N patterns storable with vanishing error. Foundation for substrate capacity analysis + Hopfield-style cleanup capacity bounds.

name: Modern Hopfield network (Ramsauer 2020)
description: Ramsauer et al 2020 'Hopfield Networks Is All You Need' modern continuous Hopfield with exponential capacity. Energy function E = -lse(beta X^T xi) yields softmax-attention update rule. Connects classical associative memory to transformer attention.

name: Bienenstock-Cooper-Munro (BCM) learning rule
description: BCM 1982 plasticity rule with sliding threshold + biologically-grounded synaptic adaptation. dw/dt proportional to x phi(y, theta_m) where phi has zero crossing at moving threshold. Foundation for substrate biologically-grounded learning extensions.

name: Glauber dynamics
description: Stochastic dynamics for spin systems + statistical mechanics: single-spin flip Markov chain with detailed-balance + Boltzmann stationary distribution. Foundation for substrate stochastic-tunneling + escape-from-local-minima + Hopfield-style annealing.

name: Complementary Learning Systems (CLS)
description: McClelland-McNaughton-O'Reilly 1995 dual-memory architecture: hippocampus (fast pattern-separation episodic) + neocortex (slow generalization semantic). Replay + consolidation mechanism. Foundation for substrate dual-substrate wrapper + episodic-semantic separation.

name: Wright-Fisher process
description: Population genetics drift process: generation t+1 allele frequencies sampled binomially from generation t. Foundation for substrate evolutionary dynamics + drift-detection (Layer 8 substrate-self-evaluation).

name: Discrete Fourier transform (DFT)
description: Linear unitary transform F: C^N -> C^N. (F x)_k = sum_n x_n exp(-2 pi i k n / N). Foundation for FHRR circular convolution via convolution theorem F(x conv y) = F(x) F(y). Substrate FHRR algebra rides on DFT.

name: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection (BOCPD)
description: Adams-MacKay 2007 BOCPD: online recursive Bayesian inference of changepoints in data stream. Maintains run-length posterior; hazard function controls changepoint rate. Foundation for substrate Layer 8 drift detection bounded by gate-frozen-at-cycle-0 architecture.
